scope: Pre-refinement quality assessment. This is not a Definition of Done and does not decide sprint readiness.

assessmentRules.sizingDisclaimer: Size is a risk signal, not a story-point estimate or a commitment by the development team.

criteria.description: Contains the pattern 'As a ... I want ... so that ...' in title or body.
criteria.passCondition: A role, goal, and benefit can be extracted.

criteria.description: Names at least product and target group; operator, platforms, and parent epic are recommended.
criteria.passCondition: Product and target group are present in structured context or clearly stated prose.
A stable epic issue reference or explicit epic identifier is present.
At least one explicit happy-path scenario and one relevant negative, empty-state, authorization, or error scenario are present. No fixed total number is required.

criteria.description: Acceptance criteria describe observable, testable outcomes.
criteria.passCondition: Each criterion has a meaningful condition, action or trigger, and verifiable outcome. Vague terms are either defined or flagged.

criteria.description: The intended user and benefit are explicit and coherent.
criteria.passCondition: The model quotes the role and benefit from the item; it must not invent business value.

criteria.description: No material duplicate or overlap with candidate stories.
criteria.passCondition: Similarity search finds no same-goal candidate, or the model explains a material distinction with evidence.

criteria.description: Flags signs that the item is likely too broad for a single sprint.
criteria.passCondition: No broadness indicators are present, or any conclusion explicitly remains a risk signal.
indicators: Multiple independent user goals or roles
Multiple products, platforms, systems, or integrations
Several independently releasable capabilities joined by 'and' or 'or'
Words such as 'all', 'complete', 'entire', or 'end-to-end' without a narrow boundary
A scope that cannot be described as one thin vertical slice

examples.title: Download invoice as PDF
examples.summary: One customer goal with a clear benefit, contextual information, an epic link, and testable happy-path plus negative/authorization scenarios.

examples.title: Manage account settings
examples.body: As a customer, I want to manage my profile, notification preferences, payment method, and security settings so that my account is up to date.
examples.expectedObservation: Several independently releasable capabilities; suggest slicing, do not estimate story points.
